description: A lightweight CLI for running single-purpose LLM agents. Define agents in TOML, give them focused context via SKILL.md files, and trigger them from cron, git hooks, pipes, or file watchers.
rules: Model strings use the models.dev format: provider/model-name
All file tools are sandboxed to the agent's workdir
Sub-agents are opaque to parents — only the final text result crosses the boundary
